prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Americium (Am) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a moonlit hill pasture of her element's kingdom — a sleeping flock, a low stone wall and a small lantern hung on a crook post
Light direction: dappled light — patches of light with leaf or blind shadow across her.
Outfit: a shepherd look fitted to her body — a short wool cape over a laced bodice and an off-shoulder chemise, a short skirt, knee socks and boots, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: sitting on the ground.
COMPOSITION: an environmental long shot, her complete figure and enough of the place around her; body in side profile, her face in profile too, not turned toward the camera, facing the right of the frame, so her own right side is toward the camera; camera slightly above, looking down at her.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand rests on her knee — her near arm, on the camera side.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand is planted on the ground beside her — her far arm, on the side away from the camera.
LEGS: legs folded cross-legged.
GAZE: she looks toward the far distance.
EXPRESSION: brows released upward and outward, eyes half closed, breath-out mouth slightly open, whole face loosened.
Scene note: she is the night shepherd keeping watch while the flock sleeps

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — americium: a soft silvery synthetic metal first identified in late 1944, born on its own as plutonium-241 decays, and named for the Americas just as europium above it was named for Europe; a speck smaller than a grain of dust sits inside household smoke detectors, gently ionizing the air between two plates, and when smoke drifts in it notices and sounds the alarm; with a half-life of 432 years it is a tiny lamp that stays awake while everyone sleeps — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: petite and short in stature yet voluptuous — a very full, heavy bust, a narrow waist and generously rounded hips on a small, compact frame, with realistic thighs and legs — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.

generation.note: Original kept; no recreation of an existing image
